svg.aria-label: 03 opc-ua-monitor. Problem: On a plant floor, an old number that looks live is worse than no number at all. Decision: Stream live values, and say plainly when a connection drops and the data goes stale. Outcome: Operators can trust what the screen tells them. On a dashboard, trust is the product.

g.text: On a plant floor, an old number
that looks live is worse than no
